test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 2)

question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

CROWN : OYRVH :: TABLE : FNEEY :: UNREAL : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

 
• CROWN : OYRVH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23c773d86eafdfcf751903fd3c53f92fccbdf365ceb72956b0035aa752c9d63f.png] 

and

 
• TABLE : FNEEY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6bf9793a6aa54e0782d2f9135cab711a307a0e680b47ddb0c5525ff476b4d26.png] 

Similarly,

 
• UNREAL : ? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e17a546ec03d44d0749effc28b9427271e3e9b2ca5cdcf7647a938dcdf16efc2.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"MCHVSA".**
